description: This file contains curated setup helpers for provider plugins that integrate local or self-hosted models, exporting types from one module and functions/constants from another related module.

methods.name: applyProviderDefaultModel
methods.description: Function to apply default model settings to provider configuration.

methods.name: configureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderNonInteractive
methods.description: Configures a self-hosted provider in a non-interactive manner.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleLocalModels
methods.description: Discovers local models compatible with OpenAI API.

methods.name: discoverOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Discovers self-hosted providers compatible with OpenAI.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProvider
methods.description: Prompts user and configures a self-hosted provider for OpenAI compatibility.

methods.name: promptAndConfigureOpenAICompatibleSelfHostedProviderAuth
methods.description: Handles user prompting and configuration for self-hosted provider authentication.
